title: Showdown Challenges
intro: Every challenge meets the same learning outcomes, so adapt any of them or create your own. Students enjoy the food challenges most, and we're keen to learn how cooking shapes their experience; if your school allows it, try Decorate, Bake or Mystery.

rows.note: Print the cards and worksheets; gather paper and colouring supplies.
Buy cupcakes and frosting the day before; a craft version works if food isn’t possible.
Book the foods room and oven; one small batch per team makes 6 cupcakes.
Bake, plus one twist: a mystery mix-in or a teamwork twist.

items.text: A · Design, or B · Decorate as its craft version.
C · Bake, or D · Mystery to add a twist.
A · Design and B · Decorate fit one class; C and D take two.

blocks.title: Before any food challenge
blocks.text: Check your school’s food rules and every student’s allergies and dietary needs against each label, including cocoa and any mystery ingredient. The recipe has no eggs or dairy but contains wheat flour.

source_note: Sources: Day 3 The Showdown (v0) teacher pages (pp. 4–7: same learning outcomes across levels, levels by materials and complexity, Level 2 craft alternative, Level 3/4 recipe and twist); the Showdown Teacher Guide and activity guides (times, prep); the food-check note formerly in the Teacher Guide's Preparation; and the user's note that food options are encouraged because students enjoy them most and we want to learn how they shape the experience (wording newly written). Allergen line derived from the Day 3 recipe ingredient list (no eggs or dairy; wheat flour); whole-lesson times add the Teacher Guide's 5 min launch and 10 min clean-up and debrief. Layout revision 2026-11-04: the Oven column merged into Food (Baked always means the oven); prep minutes moved from each note into the Prep column, replacing its Low/Medium/High rating; Encouraged flags follow the intro; the How to choose rows are newly written from the table and notes and need human review. Lesson column (2026-11-04): whole-lesson time, i.e. the Teacher Guide's 5 min intro + option time (with clean-up) + 10 min TASTE; single best estimates (human decision 2026-11-04). Intro (2026-11-04): condensed from the Day 3 'The 4 Challenges' page and its Teacher Tip (same outcomes, different materials and depth; adapt or create your own).
